title: Determinantal representation of colored HOMFLY for double braids
summary: Starting from the known differential expansions, we express the HOMFLY-PT polynomials of twist and antiparallel double-braid knots in rectangular representations \([r^s]\) as determinants of \(r\times r\) and \(s\times s\) matrices. We first give an elementary derivation for the figure-eight knot and then re-sum the KNTZ formulas for twist and double-braid evolution. The resulting matrices are constructed from single-hook evolution coefficients and explicit representation-dependent weights.
